computational_intelligence.principle: ARKI = own verifiable knowledge + explainable reasoning + own deterministic computation + rigorous evaluation + optional external tools/oracles + Human Authority
guardrails: Candidate extracted knowledge is not automatically canonical knowledge
Knowledge must carry provenance, jurisdiction, edition/validity, assumptions, units, confidence, contradictions and competency evidence
Technical computation must record inputs, method/formula, version, source, result, uncertainty and evidence
External engineering/simulation engines are validation/benchmarking oracles where feasible, not automatic permanent cognitive dependencies
Regulated calculations retain professional Human Authority
Unsupported capability states include UNKNOWN, NOT_DEMONSTRATED and PROFESSIONAL_VALIDATION_REQUIRED
proposed_sequence: benchmark harness against analytical solutions and OpenSees
reconciliation_notes: Align with existing D-2/AGK/Capability Fabric/ACS rather than create competing authorities
The older Learning Engine concept already states external engines as temporary tutors and knowledge independence
AI Laboratory/Teacher/Examiner/LearningLedger evidence must be reconciled with this architecture before promotion
